components: a central upright ending in a short angular tail
strokeOrder: start at the top left and draw the left upright straight down — then lift once
set the pen at the top left and carry the top bar to the right — then lift a second time
set the pen at the middle top and draw the central upright down
without lifting again, add the short angular tail down-left and hook its tip down-right — and only now lift
strokeOrderNote: three strokes — left upright, top bar, then the joined central upright and angular tail; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Frame 3, ர

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 3, ர (University of Texas at Austin), p. 191
strokeOrderSource.variation: Frame 3 identifies ர as the three-movement ஈ frame plus a slightly angular short fourth movement. Tamil handwriting varies by school; this is one attested three-run order fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline.

notes: The light/flapped r, distinct from ற. Its first two runs make the upright and cap; the third descends through the middle and stays joined through the small angular tail.
